questions.prompt: Where will the meeting take place?
questions.explanation: 原计划 204，改到 306；注意 instead 表示地点发生变化。
questions.audioText: Woman: Are we meeting in Room 204 this afternoon? Man: The room is being repaired. The meeting will be in Room 306 instead. Woman: What time does it start? Man: At two thirty. Please bring your project notes.

questions.explanation: 男士明确回答 At two thirty，不要被房间号干扰。

questions.explanation: 最后一句 Please bring your project notes 给出所需物品。

questions.prompt: By when should the bicycle be returned?
options: Sunday before six in the evening.
questions.explanation: until Sunday 后补充 before six in the evening，二者合起来才是完整期限。
questions.audioText: Man: I would like to borrow this bicycle until Sunday. Woman: That is fine, but please return it before six in the evening. Man: Can I leave it outside your building? Woman: No. Call me when you arrive, and I will meet you at the entrance.

questions.prompt: What should the man do when he arrives?
questions.explanation: 女士否定直接放在楼外，要求到达时打电话。
